verdicts.explanation: Table 1 places 3.80×10-6 S cm-1 in the XS1 column at 293 K, and Table S6 lists XS1 (25-0) at 3.80×10-6 S/cm at 293 K. The values were measured by EIS in this paper (Note 7), so the experimental origin is correct.

Table 1 places 9.76×10-6 S cm-1 in the XS2 column at 293 K, and Table S6 lists (0-14) XS2 at 9.76×10-6 S/cm at 293 K. The values were measured by EIS in this paper, so the experimental origin is correct.

Table 1 places 7.5×10-6 S cm-1 in the X(S1+S2) column at 293 K, and Table S6 lists (20-3) X(S1+S2) at 7.5×10-6 S/cm at 293 K. The values were measured by EIS in this paper, so the experimental origin is correct.
